title: When the Ember Breaks
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Rafael Almeida, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
